title: Lesson 14: Data Architecture: Data Model Design, Common Data Model Patterns, and Data Skew
description: Data is the load-bearing wall of every org. Designing a data model that scales means deciding where each relationship lives, recognizing the recurring shapes that solve real problems, and keeping the load off any single parent record or owner. This lesson covers data model design, the common patterns (one-to-many, many-to-many, hierarchical, and data tiering), and the three data skews that quietly break performance.
